verses.geez: ቦ፡ ብሔር፡ እምኀበ፡ ይወፅአ፡ ብሩር፡ ለወርቅኒ፡ ቦ፡ ብሔር፡ እምኀበ፡ የአርርዎ።
verses.translation: For there is a place for the silver, whence it comes, and a place for the gold, whence it is refined.

translations.lxx: For there is a place for the silver, whence it comes, and a place for the gold, whence it is refined.
translations.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
translations.ron: Argintul are zăcămintele lui de obârşie şi aurul are locul lui de unde-l scoţi şi-l lămureşti.
translations.grk: Ἐστι γὰρ ἀργυρίῳ τόπος ὅθεν γίνεται, τόπος δὲ χρυσίου ὅθεν διηθεῖται.

verses.geez: ሐፂንሂ፡ እምውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትገበር፡ ለብርትኒ፡ ከመ፡ እብን፡ ይፈጽሕዎ።
verses.translation: For iron comes out of the earth, and brass is hewn out like stone.

translations.lxx: For iron comes out of the earth, and brass is hewn out like stone.
translations.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
translations.ron: Din pământ scoatem fierul şi din stânca topită scoatem arama.
translations.grk: Σίδηρος μὲν γὰρ ἐκ γῆς γίνεται, χαλκὸς δὲ ἶσα λίθῳ λατομεῖται.

verses.geez: ለጽልመትኒ፡ አዘዘ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ወለኵሉ፡ ውእቱ፡ የሐትቶ፡ እብነ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወጽላሎተ፡ ሞት።
verses.translation: He has set a bound to darkness, and he searches out every limit: a stone is darkness, and the shadow of death.

translations.lxx: He has set a bound to darkness, and he searches out every limit: a stone is darkness, and the shadow of death.
translations.kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
translations.ron: Omul a pus hotare întunericului şi cercetează până în cele mai depărtate adâncuri, sfredelind piatra ascunsă în umbră şi în beznă.
translations.grk: Τάξιν ἔθετο σκότει, καὶ πᾶν πέρας αὐτὸς ἐξακριβάζεται, λίθος σκοτία, καὶ σκιὰ θανάτου.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ስጥቀተ፡ ፈለግ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ እለ፡ ይረስዕዋ፡ ለፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ደክሙ፡ በኃጢአቶሙ።
verses.translation: There is a cutting off of the torrent by reason of dust: so they that forget the right way are weakened; they are removed from among men.

translations.lxx: There is a cutting off of the torrent by reason of dust: so they that forget the right way are weakened; they are removed from among men.
translations.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
translations.ron: Un popor străin a săpat cărări pe sub pământ, uitate de piciorul celor de deasupra şi departe de oameni; scormonitorii se spânzură pe funii şi se clatină încoace şi în colo.
translations.grk: Διακοπὴ χειμάῤῥου ἀπὸ κονίας, οἱ δὲ ἐπιλανθανόμενοι ὁδὸν δικαίαν ἠσθένησαν, ἐκ βροτῶν ἐσαλεύθησαν.

verses.geez: ለምድርኒ፡ ይወፅእ፡ እምኔሃ፡ እክል፡ በመትሕቴሃኒ፡ ጠብለላ፡ በእሳት።
verses.translation: As for the earth, out of it shall come bread: under it has been turned up as it were fire.

translations.lxx: As for the earth, out of it shall come bread: under it has been turned up as it were fire.
translations.kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
translations.ron: Şi deasupra este pământul din care iese pâinea, dar pe dedesubt este răvăşit ca de foc.
translations.grk: Γῆ, ἐξ αὐτῆς ἐξελεύσεται ἄρτος, ὑποκάτω αὐτῆς ἐστράφη ὡσεὶ πῦρ.

verses.geez: ቦ፡ ብሔር፡ ዘአብነ፡ ሰንፔር፡ ወወርቃኒ፡ ከመ፡ መሬት።
verses.translation: Her stones are the place of the sapphire: and her dust supplies man with gold.

translations.lxx: Her stones are the place of the sapphire: and her dust supplies man with gold.
translations.kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
translations.ron: Aici pietrele lui sunt de safir, dincoace sunt puzderii de aur,
translations.grk: Τόπος σαπφείρου οἱ λίθοι αὐτῆς, καὶ χῶμα χρυσίον αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ፍኖት፡ ዘኢርአያ፡ ዖፍ፡ ወዘኢነጸራ፡ ዓይን፡ ንስር።
verses.translation: There is a path, the fowl has not known it, neither has the eye of the vulture seen it:

translations.lxx: There is a path, the fowl has not known it, neither has the eye of the vulture seen it:
translations.kjv: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
translations.ron: Cărări pe care nu le-a cunoscut pasărea de pradă şi pe care ochiul vulturului nu şi le-a însemnat.
translations.grk: Τρίβος, οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτὴν πετεινὸν, καὶ οὐ παρέβλεψεν αὐτὴν ὀφθαλμὸς γυπός·

verses.geez: ወኢኬድዋ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ዝኁራን፡ በእግር፡ ወኢኃለፈ፡ አንበሳ፡ ውስቴታ።
verses.translation: neither have the sons of the proud trodden it, a lion has not passed upon it.

translations.lxx: neither have the sons of the proud trodden it, a lion has not passed upon it.
translations.kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
translations.ron: Fiarele sălbatice nu le-au călcat niciodată, niciodată leul nu s-a strecurat pe aici.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐπάτησαν αὐτὸν υἱοὶ ἀλαζόνων, οὐ παρῆλθεν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς λέων.

verses.geez: ወአንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ በእዝኅ፡ ወአጥፍኦሙ፡ ለአድባር፡ እመሠረቶሙ፡ ወእምሥርዎሙ።
verses.translation: He has stretched forth his hand on the sharp rock, and turned up mountains by the roots:

translations.lxx: He has stretched forth his hand on the sharp rock, and turned up mountains by the roots:
translations.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
translations.ron: Dar omul a ajuns cu mâna lui la aceste stânci de cremene şi munţii i-a răsturnat din temelie.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἀκροτόμῳ ἐξέτεινε χεῖρα αὐτοῦ, κατέστρεψε δὲ ἐκ ῥιζῶν ὄρη.

verses.geez: ወሰጠቀ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ አፍላግ፡ ወርእየ፡ ዓይንየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ክቡራተ።
verses.translation: and he has interrupted the whirlpools of rivers, and mine eye has seen every precious thing.

translations.lxx: and he has interrupted the whirlpools of rivers, and mine eye has seen every precious thing.
translations.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
translations.ron: El a săpat şanţuri în stânci şi nimic de preţ nu scapă privirii lui.
translations.grk: Δίνας δὲ ποταμῶν διέῤῥηξε, πᾶν δὲ ἔντιμον εἴδέ μου ὁ ὀφθαλμός.

verses.geez: ወሰጠቀ፡ ቀላያተ፡ ዘአፍላግ፡ ወአርአየኃይሎ፡ በውስተ፡ ብርሃን።
verses.translation: And he has laid bare the depths of rivers, and has brought his power to light.

translations.lxx: And he has laid bare the depths of rivers, and has brought his power to light.
translations.kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
translations.ron: El a răscolit izvoarele apelor şi tot ce era în adâncime a scos afară la lumină.
translations.grk: Βάθη δὲ ποταμῶν ἀνεκάλυψεν, ἔδειξε δὲ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν εἰς φῶς.

verses.geez: ወእምአይቴ፡ ተረክበት፡ ጥበብ፡ ወአይቴ፡ ብሔር፡ ለጥበብ።
verses.translation: But whence has wisdom been discovered? and what is the place of knowledge?

translations.lxx: But whence has wisdom been discovered? and what is the place of knowledge?
translations.kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
translations.ron: Dar înţelepciunea de unde izvorăşte ea şi care este locul de obârşie al priceperii?
translations.grk: Ἡ δὲ σοφία πόθεν εὑρέθη; ποῖος δὲ τόπος ἐστὶ τῆς ἐπιστήμης;

verses.geez: ወኢየአምራ፡ መዋቲ፡ ለፍኖታ፡ ወኢሀለወት፡ ኀበ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው።
verses.translation: A mortal has not known its way, neither indeed has it been discovered among men.

translations.lxx: A mortal has not known its way, neither indeed has it been discovered among men.
translations.kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
translations.ron: Pământeanul nu cunoaşte calea către ea, căci ea nu se găseşte pe meleagurile celor vii.
translations.grk: Οὐκ οἶδε βροτὸς ὁδὸν αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ μὴν εὑρέθη ἐν ἀνθρώποις.

verses.geez: ቀላይኒ፡ ትቤ፡ ኢህለወት፡ ኀቤየሰ፡ ወባሕርኒ፡ ትቤ፡ ኢነበረት፡ ምስሌየሰ።
verses.translation: The depth said, It is not in me: and the sea said, It is not with me.

translations.lxx: The depth said, It is not in me: and the sea said, It is not with me.
translations.kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
translations.ron: Adâncul a grăit: Ea nu se află în sânul meu! Şi marea a spus la fel: Ea nu este la mine!
translations.grk: Ἄβυσσος εἶπεν, οὐκ ἔνεστιν ἐν ἐμοί· καὶ ἡ θάλασσα εἶπεν, οὐκ ἔνεστι μετʼ ἐμοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘተረክበ፡ ዘክማሓ፡ ወኢይደልዋ፡ ብሩር፡ ተውላጣ።
verses.translation: One shall not give fine gold instead of it, neither shall silver be weighed in exchange for it.

translations.lxx: One shall not give fine gold instead of it, neither shall silver be weighed in exchange for it.
translations.kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
translations.ron: Mintea cea înaltă nu poate fi schimbată cu bulgări de aur şi argintul nu-l cântăreşti ca s-o plăteşti.
translations.grk: Οὐ δώσει συνκλεισμὸν ἀντʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐ σταθήσεται ἀργύριον ἀντάλλαγμα αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢትሠየጥ፡ በወርቀ፡ አፌር፡ ወኢ፡ በባላቅ፡ ቅድው፡ ወበ፡ ሰንፔር።
verses.translation: Neither shall it be compared with gold of Sophir, with the precious onyx and sapphire.

translations.lxx: Neither shall it be compared with gold of Sophir, with the precious onyx and sapphire.
translations.kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
translations.ron: Ea nu poate să fie preţuită nici cu aurul Ofirului, nici cu preţioasa cornalină, nici cu pietre de safir!
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐ συνβασταχθήσεται χρυσίῳ Σωφεὶρ, ἐν ὄνυχι τιμίῳ καὶ σαπφείρῳ.

verses.geez: ወኢትማሰላ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወማኅው፡ ወቤዛሃኒ፡ ንዋየ፡ ወርቅ።
verses.translation: Gold and crystal shall not be equalled to it, neither shall vessels of gold be its exchange.

translations.lxx: Gold and crystal shall not be equalled to it, neither shall vessels of gold be its exchange.
translations.kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
translations.ron: Cu ea alături nu pot să stea nici aurul, nici cristalul şi cu un vas din aurul cel mai curat nu se poate schimba ea.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἰσωθήσεται αὐτῇ χρυσίον καὶ ὕαλος, καὶ τὸ ἄλλαγμα αὐτῆς σκεύη χρυσᾶ.

verses.geez: ዝሉፍ፡ ወእንቡዝ፡ ኢይዜክርዋ፡ ወሰሐባ፡ ለጥበብ፡ እምአፅናቊ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ኃይልከ፡፡ 19፡ ወኢይርዔረያ፡ ተንከራ፡ ዘኢትዮጲያ፡ ወኢትሠየጥ፡ በወርቅ፡ ጽሩይ።
verses.translation: Coral and fine pearl shall not be mentioned: but do thou esteem wisdom above the most precious things.

translations.lxx: Coral and fine pearl shall not be mentioned: but do thou esteem wisdom above the most precious things.
translations.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
translations.ron: Despre mărgean şi despre diamant, nici să mai pomenim, iar agonisirea înţelepciunii întrece cu mult pe aceea a mărgăritarelor.
translations.grk: Μετέωρα καὶ γαβὶς οὐ μνησθήσεται, καὶ ἕλκυσον σοφίαν ὑπὲρ τὰ ἐσώτατα.

verses.geez: ወጥበብ፡ በአይቴ፡ ተረክበት፡ ወአይቴ፡ ውእቱ፡ ብሔር፡ ለምክር።
verses.translation: Whence then is wisdom found? and of what kind is the place of understanding?

translations.lxx: Whence then is wisdom found? and of what kind is the place of understanding?
translations.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
translations.ron: Şi această înţelepciune de unde vine ea şi care este sălaşul priceperii?
translations.grk: Ἡ δὲ σοφία πόθεν εὑρέθη; ποῖος δὲ τόπος ἐστὶ τῆς συνέσεως;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ተረስዓት፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወተኃብአት፡ ዓዲ፡ እምአዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: It has escaped the notice of every man, and has been hidden from the birds of the sky.

translations.lxx: It has escaped the notice of every man, and has been hidden from the birds of the sky.
translations.kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
translations.ron: Ea a fost ascunsă de ochii oricărei făpturi vii; ea a fost tăinuită şi de pasărea cerului.
translations.grk: Λέληθε πάντα ἄνθρωπον, καὶ ἀπὸ πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκρύβη.

verses.geez: ሞትሂ፡ ወሲኦል፡ ይቤሉ፡ ሰማዕነ፡ ድምፃ።
verses.translation: Destruction and Death said, We have heard the report of it.

translations.lxx: Destruction and Death said, We have heard the report of it.
translations.kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
translations.ron: Adâncul şi moartea au zis: Noi am auzit vorbindu-se de ea.
translations.grk: Ἡ ἀπώλεια καὶ ὁ θάνατος εἶπαν, ἀκηκόαμεν δὲ αὐτῆς τὸ κλέος.

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ አሠነየ፡ ፍታ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ለሊሁ፡ የአምር፡ ብሔራ።
verses.translation: God has well ordered the way of it, and he knows the place of it.

translations.lxx: God has well ordered the way of it, and he knows the place of it.
translations.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
translations.ron: Dumnezeu îi cunoaşte drumul şi numai El este Cel ce ştie locuinţa ei.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς εὖ συνέστησεν αὐτῆς τὴν ὁδὸν, αὐτὸς δὲ οἶδε τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ይሬኢ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወየአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: For he surveys the whole earth under heaven, knowing the things in the earth:

translations.lxx: For he surveys the whole earth under heaven, knowing the things in the earth:
translations.kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
translations.ron: Când El privea până la marginile pământului şi îmbrăţişa cu ochii tot ce se află sub ceruri,
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς γὰρ τὴν ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν πᾶσαν ἐφορᾷ· εἰδὼς τὰ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα

verses.geez: ዘለሊሁ፡ ገብረ፡ ነፋሳተ፡ በመዳልው፡ ወማየሂ፡ በመስፈርት።
verses.translation: all that he has made; the weight of the winds, the measures of the water.

translations.lxx: all that he has made; the weight of the winds, the measures of the water.
translations.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
translations.ron: Ca să dea vântului cumpănă şi să chibzuiască legea apelor,
translations.grk: ἃ ἐποίησεν, ἀνέμων σταθμὸν, ὕδατος μέτρα ὅτε ἐποίησεν·

verses.geez: አመ፡ ፈጠረ፡ ከመዝ፡ አእሚሮ፡ ኈለቃ፡ አመ፡ ገብረ፡ ለዝናም፡ ሥርዓተ፡ ወበፍኖት፡ ያሜክርዎ፡ ለቃል።
verses.translation: When he made them, thus he saw and numbered them, and made a way for the pealing of the thunder.

translations.lxx: When he made them, thus he saw and numbered them, and made a way for the pealing of the thunder.
translations.kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
translations.ron: Când El statornicea ploilor un făgaş şi o cale bubuitului tunetului,
translations.grk: οὕτως ἰδὼν ἠρίθμησε, καὶ ὁδὸν ἐν τινάγματι φωνάς.

verses.geez: ወርአያ፡ አሜሁ፡ ወኈለቃ፡ ወአስተዳለዋ፡ ወአክበራ፡ ወሰሐባ።
verses.translation: Then he saw it, and declared it: he prepared it and traced it out.

translations.lxx: Then he saw it, and declared it: he prepared it and traced it out.
translations.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
translations.ron: Atunci El a văzut înţelepciunea şi a cântărit-o, atunci a pus-o în lumină şi i-a măsurat adâncimea.
translations.grk: Τότε εἶδεν αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐξηγήσατο αὐτὴν, ἑτοιμάσας ἐξιχνίασεν.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ናሁ፡ ፈሪሃ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወተግኅሦ፡ እምኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ አእምሮ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: And he said to man, Behold, godliness is wisdom; and to abstain from evil is understanding.

translations.lxx: And he said to man, Behold, godliness is wisdom; and to abstain from evil is understanding.
translations.kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the LORD, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
translations.ron: După aceea Dumnezeu a zis omului: Iată, frica de Dumnezeu, aceasta este înţelepciunea, iar în depărtarea de cel rău stă priceperea".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ ἀνθρώπῳ, Ἰδοὺ ἡ θεοσέβειά ἐστι σοφία, τὸ δὲ ἀπέχεσθαι ἀπὸ κακῶν ἐστὶν ἐπιστήμη.
